SOURCE III — FULL COUPERIN PERFORMANCE AND ELECTRONIC REVOICING

Human performance
François Couperin — L’Art de toucher le clavecin (complete).
Harpsichord: David Joseph Stith, Gerald Self instrument built in 2020.
Recorded 27 January 2021. Original recording released under CC0 1.0:
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fran%C3%A7ois_Couperin_%22L%27Art_de_toucher_le_Clavecin%22.wav
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Source SHA256: f9a9f0cefd38a4b7742f25e7636f88830b8a8ceed41167da7193426d0f80ae3a

Score and electronic revoicing
The underlying Couperin composition is public domain. The score MIDI
transcription is by Nicolas Sceaux for the Mutopia Project, CC BY 2.5:
https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=907
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/
It was aligned to the human performance and adapted into a user-edited Live
arrangement; the user adjusted MIDI pitch by ear. The original composition's
full sequence and irregular timing are retained approximately. Score
alignment and realization of some ornaments remain approximate.

The human performance is credited to David Joseph Stith. The game does not
attribute this harpsichord performance to the player or developer.
Source II’s Bach Chaconne is the separate developer-supplied
marimba recording. No Couperin source claim extends to that performance.

Prepared carrier
public/audio/source-rest/couperin/couperin-revoiced-pair.mp3
SHA256: 908c1b5d2bd37f644baab797f9e47ea9fa7b34ec6422087aca86f6b0a9c42495
32 kHz, two independent mono channels in one 192 kbps MP3, 843.15746875 seconds.
Left: human performance; right: the edited electronic arrangement. A common
encoded clock keeps both aligned, and the game blends them as sources.
The Live export was 320 kbps stereo MP3, re-encoded as 192 kbps; this is a
lossy-to-lossy path. The export's stereo field was folded to mono for the
existing paired-carrier format. A constant -15.33 dB was applied
to match acoustic integrated loudness, without dynamic processing. Native
gameplay listening remains unverified.

Previous audio and provenance are preserved in artifacts/couperin-live12/
integration/previous-production/. The old automatic transcription may introduce
omissions or octave errors; the replacement instead follows edited score MIDI.
